Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.32.0 rebuilds the Portable Fortress art and fixes its entrance. The old body was a single 64x64 near-black texture with every face sampling the whole image, so the fortress rendered dark no matter the lighting; it now ships a 1024 UV atlas with 16 material regions (fog-blue armour, silver structure, bronze framing, warm plaster, wood, leather, cloth, hearth fire) and 387 authored parts covering a furnished living deck, an observation deck with command console, benches and chart table, and a guarded roof. The entrance no longer needs a jump: the level-1 floor proxy used to run to the envelope edge and put an unstep-able 0.36 body lip across the doorway, the last stair tread overshot the deck by 0.12, and the hidden threshold blocks were shielded by that lip. Glazing is drawn in its own alpha-blended pass because the component model shader has no blended stage, and carries thin collision proxies. Interior brightness uses a low warm emission floor plus additive lamp quads; terrain light cells were evaluated and rejected because entity shells do not block them. All vehicle, plant, industrial and Skywrath features are unchanged. Android 7723 rendering, entrance traversal, glazing readability and multiplayer remain pending device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
